config.allthingsfoliage.always_leaf_walk: Treat players as having Leaf Walker at all times. Fall-damage and movement-speed modifiers are bypassed.
config.allthingsfoliage.ambient_waving.t: Enable gentle foliage movement during clear weather. Weather-driven wind is configured separately.
config.allthingsfoliage.bending_strength: Adjust how strongly foliage bends when pushed by entities. Higher values produce stronger bending.
Prevent leaves from covering the player's view while the player is inside them.
config.allthingsfoliage.entity_bending.t: Allow nearby entities to push foliage. This setting does not control passability, ambient waving, or weather wind.
config.allthingsfoliage.fall_damage_mult: Percentage of normal fall damage taken when landing in leaves. Zero prevents this damage; 100% preserves normal damage.
config.allthingsfoliage.fall_damage_thre: Distance an entity must fall before taking damage when landing in leaves.
config.allthingsfoliage.gpu_distance.too:
Set the area handled by the GPU foliage renderer.

Performance: Covers the entity interaction area.
Adaptive: Uses a share of render distance that decreases as render distance increases.
Half: Uses half your render distance.
Full: Uses your entire render distance.

Plants beyond this area remain in the normal chunk mesh. Greater distances may increase rendering cost.
config.allthingsfoliage.horizontal_speed: Percentage of normal horizontal movement speed while passing through leaves.
config.allthingsfoliage.interaction_radi: Distance around the player where entities can push foliage. Larger distances may increase processing cost.
config.allthingsfoliage.modify_pathfindi: Allow mob pathfinding to treat leaves as passable instead of avoiding them.
config.allthingsfoliage.passability_play: Allow only players to pass through leaves. Other entities retain normal leaf collision.
config.allthingsfoliage.preset.label: Graphics Preset
config.allthingsfoliage.preset.tooltip:
Apply a predefined combination of entity bending, renderer, render distance, ambient waving, and weather wind settings.

Preserves bending strength, interaction radius, waving strength, waving leaves, targeting, and passability settings.

Unmatched combinations appear as Custom.
config.allthingsfoliage.renderer.label: Renderer
config.allthingsfoliage.renderer.tooltip:
GPU: Uses the mod's foliage renderer and enables ambient waving and weather wind.

CPU: Uses the normal chunk mesh for foliage interaction.
config.allthingsfoliage.requires.fancy_l: Requires Fancy leaves in Video Settings.
config.allthingsfoliage.requires.gpu_onl: The CPU renderer is unavailable in the current setup.
config.allthingsfoliage.requires.interac: Enable Entity Bending to change this setting.
config.allthingsfoliage.requires.leaf_wa: Disable Always Walk on Leaves to change this setting.
config.allthingsfoliage.requires.waving: Enable Ambient Waving to change this setting.
config.allthingsfoliage.requires.weather: Enable Weather Wind to change this setting.
config.allthingsfoliage.save.tooltip: Save all settings and return to the previous screen.
config.allthingsfoliage.scroll.down.tool: Show settings below. You can also use the mouse wheel.
config.allthingsfoliage.scroll.up.toolti: Show settings above. You can also use the mouse wheel.
config.allthingsfoliage.solid_leaves_bel: Restore leaf collision when an entity approaches from underneath, preventing upward passage through leaves.
config.allthingsfoliage.sound_volume.too: Volume multiplier for movement sounds inside leaves. Zero mutes these sounds; 1.00× uses normal volume.
config.allthingsfoliage.sounds_players_o: Allow only players to produce movement sounds inside leaves.
Leaf collision, fall damage, movement, and sound settings.
config.allthingsfoliage.tab.wind.tooltip: Ambient foliage movement and weather-driven wind.
config.allthingsfoliage.target_alive_onl: Ignore entities that have died but are still playing their death animation, so they no longer absorb hits.
config.allthingsfoliage.title: All Things Foliage
config.allthingsfoliage.vertical_speed.t: Percentage of normal vertical movement speed while passing through leaves.
config.allthingsfoliage.waving_leaves.to: Include eligible leaves in ambient foliage movement.
Adjust the strength of foliage waving. This is separate from bending caused by entities.
config.allthingsfoliage.weather_wind.too: Apply weather-driven wind during rain and storms, accounting for shelter from roofs and walls.
config.allthingsfoliage.weather_wind_dis:
Set the area affected by weather wind.

Performance: Covers the entity interaction area.
Half: Covers half the GPU renderer's area.
Full: Covers the entire GPU renderer's area.
Allows the player to walk on foliage blocks.
